chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from al-Hasan, from Zur'ah, from Sama'ah, who said:

Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام said: The dawn prayer and the maghrib prayer are not performed except with adhan and iqamah. Concession was given in the rest of the prayers for iqamah alone, though the adhan is more excellent.

key_terms.أَذَانٍ: the call to prayer announced before salat
key_terms.أَفْضَلُ: more virtuous and superior in merit
key_terms.إِقَامَةٍ: the second call signaling the immediate start of salat
key_terms.الْغَدَاةُ: the dawn prayer, meaning salat al-fajr
key_terms.رُخِّصَ: a concession or allowance was granted

ai.seo_question: Is adhan and iqamah required for fajr and maghrib prayer in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the adhan and iqamah for salat. It states that salat al-ghadah and salat al-maghrib are not to be performed except with both adhan and iqamah, while in the other prayers iqamah alone is permitted, though the adhan remains superior.
